question: Who is know as the Father of Geology?
solution:
The correct answer is **__James Hutton__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• James Hutton is known as the Father of Geology.

 
 
• He formulated geological principles on the basis of his observations of rocks.
 
• He was a Scottish naturalist, physician, and geologist.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 E. J. Butler :

 
 
• Sir Edwin John Butler was an Irish mycologist and plant pathologist who became the Imperial Mycologist in India.
 
• He is noted for identifying 150 species of plant pathogenic fungi.
 
 
 
• Alfred Wegener:
 
 
• The Continental Drift Theory was given by Alfred Wegener in 1912.
